messages:
Aisha Khan: FYI manager flagged a promo for an E3 -> E4 (engineering) in India, effective 2026-03-01. they asked what documentation we actually need and whether bonus/equity are prorat-ed for the effective date. any quick guidance?
Daniel Reed: short: we need the Promo Evidence bundle + comp-change in Workday. Bonus and equity proration depends on plan rules. Typically base changes prorat-ed from the effective date; bonus target % is updated but payout proration follows the annual bonus policy. equity grants are separate (new grant vs. refresh), coordinate with comp.
Sofia Park: can you clarify "Promo Evidence bundle"? manager wants a checklist to hand to the IC.
Daniel Reed: sure bundle = 1) Promo Evidence form, 2) 1-page bullets linking to rubric axes, 3) 2 manager statements (scope + org impact), 4) before/after role bullets, and 5) short links to key PRs or project dashboards. keep files small (PDF or Google doc).
Tom Li: adding regional nuance: for India we file comp-change in INR. payroll will calculate retro in INR and mail an FX note. If the promo crosses fiscal year in India, tax withholding can differ; get local tax docs early.
Aisha Khan: manager also asked whether we ever do retro to the hire date if comp-change was delayed. what's the limit?
Sofia Park: policy: retro can go back up to 180 days with VP signoff; beyond 180 days we need an exception and payback justification. retro > $15k automatically triggers comp committee review.
Daniel Reed: put this in the ticket: expected retro USD estimate and reason for delay. that speeds approvals.
people-bot: Promo Evidence checklist template uploaded (#T-11011).
Aisha Khan: great. what about bonus proration example? manager wants a concrete calc to show the IC.
Tom Li: example: if annual bonus target = 10% and effective 2026-03-01, for a calendar-year bonus paid Dec, we prorate months at new target from March to Dec (10/12 of target) unless plan says otherwise. for sign-on or performance bonuses, treat separately and confirm with comp ops.
Sofia Park: note: for equity, if manager wants to grant a promo equity refresh, submit an option grant request separate from comp-change; include vesting schedule and grant date (usually aligned to promo effective date).
Aisha Khan: who nudges the employee to upload local tax forms? manager or people-ops?
Tom Li: manager should nudge; people-ops will follow up if Workday shows missing docs. include checklist item in the ticket: "Employee has uploaded local tax forms / PAN / KYC".
Daniel Reed: quick ticket checklist the manager can paste into Workday:
```
- Upload Promo Evidence form (1-page bullets + 2 manager statements)
- Attach before/after job summary + org chart snippet
- Submit comp-change (currency = INR) and include USD equivalent
- Include estimated retro amount (USD) and reason for delay
- Confirm employee has submitted tax/KYC docs in Workday
- Tag @people-payroll and @comp-ops
- If retro > 180 days or > $15k, mark for VP approval
```
Sofia Park: I'll follow up with comp-ops to pre-check the USD conversion so manager has a budget number.
Aisha Khan: thanks all  I'll send this checklist to the manager now.
people-bot: comp-change ticket created (#C-8022). people-payroll notified.
